page.title: Tia
page.subtitle: Set up the in-product assistant for your staff.
page.whoCanConfigure: Only people with the "Manage AI agents" permission can set up Tia. The Owner always has it.
page.loadError: Tia's setup could not be loaded.

create.title: Create Tia
create.subtitle: Tia answers your staff from your apps, in their language, with only the access each person already has.

summary.deactivateBody: Tia disappears for everyone until you deploy it again. Past chats are kept.
summary.undeployedChanges: You have changes that are not live yet. Deploy to apply them.

blocked.noTools: Choose at least one of Tia's tools before you deploy.
blocked.writeModulesRequired: Tia can propose record changes, so choose the modules it may change before you deploy.
blocked.customActionsRequired: Tia can propose running actions, so choose which actions before you deploy.

switch.title: Tia switch
switch.subtitle: Turns Tia on or off for the whole workspace. It is separate from the switch for customer agents.
switch.conflict: Someone changed the AI settings at the same time. The latest state is shown; try again.
switch.saveError: The switch could not be saved.
switch.loadError: The AI settings could not be loaded.
switch.readOnlyUnknown: Tia's switch could not be checked
switch.readOnlyBody: Only people with the "Manage AI policy" permission can change it.

audience.title: Who can use Tia
audience.subtitle: Only people whose profile has the "Chat with Tia" permission can use Tia.
audience.onlyHelp: Narrow Tia to the people you choose, from the whole workspace.
audience.stateOnly: Only {{profiles}} profiles and {{users}} users can use Tia.
audience.nobodyWarning: No profiles or users are chosen, so Tia is hidden from everyone.
audience.profilesForbidden: Seeing the list of profiles needs the "Manage Agent Studio" or "Manage profiles" permission.
audience.adminsHelp: The default. The built-in Admin profiles come with the "Chat with Tia" permission; a custom admin profile does not get it on its own. To let anyone else use Tia, including people on a custom admin profile, give their profile that permission in Profiles.
audience.stateAdmins: Admins can use Tia, and so can anyone whose profile you give the "Chat with Tia" permission in Profiles.
audience.cutWarning: Only the first {{max}} profiles and the first {{max}} users are kept. Choose fewer, or use a profile instead of many users.

areas.title: Setup areas
areas.subtitle: Choose what Tia may explain, and where it may propose changes. Every change still needs a person to confirm it, and anything that can run on its own is saved off.
areas.loadError: The setup areas could not be loaded.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Tia sees reports exactly as the person asking does: their own records and fields, plus the report access you grant.
reports.whoCanOpen: Report access is managed by people with the "Manage report access" permission.

save.failed: Your changes could not be saved.
save.savedToDraft: Saved. Deploy Tia to apply it.
save.conflict: Someone else changed Tia's settings after you opened this page, so nothing was saved. Reload to see the latest settings, then make your change again.

limit.zeroWarning: A limit of 0 stops everyone from using Tia. Leave it empty for no limit.
limit.invalid: Enter 0 or more credits, or leave it empty for no limit.
limit.topicsCut: Tia keeps up to {{max}} topics in each list, each up to {{chars}} characters. Topics past that are dropped when you save.

appsCard.title: Apps
appsCard.subtitle: The apps Tia appears in.
appsCard.noneWarning: Tick at least one app. To hide Tia everywhere, turn off the Tia switch instead.

tia_search.name: Search everything
tia_search.description: Finds records, tickets, chats and articles across the apps the user can open.

tia_listModules.name: List modules
tia_listModules.description: Lists the modules the user can read.

tia_describeModule.name: Describe a module
tia_describeModule.description: Explains a module’s fields and layouts.

tia_listRecords.name: List records
tia_listRecords.description: Lists records the user can see, with filters.

tia_getRecord.name: Open a record
tia_getRecord.description: Reads one record the user can see.

tia_countRecords.name: Count records
tia_countRecords.description: Counts records the user can see.

tia_getTicketThread.name: Read a ticket thread
tia_getTicketThread.description: Reads the messages of a Desk ticket.

tia_listConversations.name: List chats
tia_listConversations.description: Lists Omnichannel chats the user can see.

tia_getConversationMessages.name: Read a chat
tia_getConversationMessages.description: Reads the messages of a chat.

tia_countConversations.name: Count chats
tia_countConversations.description: Counts chats the user can see.

tia_listReports.name: List reports
tia_listReports.description: Lists the reports the user can open.

tia_runReport.name: Run a report
tia_runReport.description: Runs a saved report with the user’s own data access.

tia_getBlueprint.name: Read a blueprint
tia_getBlueprint.description: Explains a blueprint’s stages and transitions.

tia_listActions.name: List actions
tia_listActions.description: Lists the actions the user can run.

tia_teamPerformance.name: Team performance
tia_teamPerformance.description: Summarises the team’s activity and results.

tia_userActivity.name: User activity
tia_userActivity.description: Summarises what a person has worked on.

tia_explainAssignment.name: Explain an assignment
tia_explainAssignment.description: Says which rule assigned a record, ticket or chat, and why.

tia_proposeCreateRecord.name: Propose a new record
tia_proposeCreateRecord.description: Prepares a record for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeUpdateRecord.name: Propose a record change
tia_proposeUpdateRecord.description: Prepares a change for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeAddNote.name: Propose a note
tia_proposeAddNote.description: Prepares a note on a record for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeTicketComment.name: Propose a ticket comment
tia_proposeTicketComment.description: Prepares a comment on a ticket for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeKbDraft.name: Propose an article draft
tia_proposeKbDraft.description: Prepares a knowledge base draft for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeRunAction.name: Propose running an action
tia_proposeRunAction.description: Prepares an allowed action for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeCreateWorkflow.name: Propose a workflow
tia_proposeCreateWorkflow.description: Prepares a workflow rule, saved off, for the user to confirm.

tia_proposeCreateBlueprint.name: Propose a blueprint
tia_proposeCreateBlueprint.description: Prepares a blueprint, saved off, for the user to confirm.

tia_listSetupAreas.name: List setup areas
tia_listSetupAreas.description: Lists the setup areas Tia may use for this user.

tia_describeSetup.name: Explain a setup
tia_describeSetup.description: Explains who a rule affects, when it runs and what it does.

tia_proposeSetupChange.name: Propose a setup change
tia_proposeSetupChange.description: Prepares a setup change, saved off, for the user to confirm.

tia_productGuide.name: Product guide
tia_productGuide.description: Answers how-to questions from the product guide, and cites the page.

defaultTools: Tia starts with its standard tools: reading records, chats and reports, team performance, setup help and the product guide. Add tools here only to choose a different set; you can change them later.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: You have changes on this page that are not saved. If you leave, they are lost.

caps.title: Workspace allowance
caps.subtitle: The most AI credits Tia may use across the whole workspace. Each person's own daily limit is set when you edit Tia.
caps.invalid: Enter 0 or more credits, or leave it empty for no cap.
caps.tooHigh: The most allowed is {{max}} credits. Enter a lower number, or leave it empty for no cap.
caps.scaleUnknown: The credit scale could not be read, so the allowance can't be changed right now.
caps.monthlyBelowDaily: The monthly allowance is lower than the daily one, so Tia would stop before the daily allowance is used.
caps.none: No workspace allowance: Tia can use credits until the workspace runs out.
caps.zeroWarning: An allowance of 0 stops Tia for everyone. Leave it empty for no cap.
caps.readOnly: Only people with the "Manage AI policy" permission can change the workspace allowance.
caps.loadError: The AI settings could not be loaded.

strongSteps.title: Stronger model
strongSteps.subtitle: Tia answers with the standard model. When a hard request fails, it may try once more with a stronger model, which costs more credits. Lower how often that can happen.
strongSteps.workspaceLabel: For the workspace per day (0 to {{max}})
strongSteps.zeroMeansNever: 0 means Tia never uses the stronger model. Leave a field empty to keep the default.
strongSteps.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}, or leave it empty for the default.
strongSteps.conflict: Someone changed these limits or the agent runtime settings after you opened this page, so nothing was saved. Reload to see the latest settings, then make your change again.
strongSteps.loadError: The stronger-model limits couldn't be loaded.
